senses.gloss: N. of a plant or tree. °वनम् a grove of such trees.

[ऋ-इनच्-किदिच्च [[Uṇ. 2. 51.]]] 
__1 A salt-ground, saline soil; यथेरिणे बीजमुप्त्बा न वप्ता लभते फलम् [[Ms. 3. 142]]; [[Y. 1. 151.]] 
__2 Hence, a bare or barren soil, desert, dreary region. 
__3 Non-support. 
__4 A rivulet, well (Ved.). 
__5 A hollow, hole. 
__6 A dice-board; प्रवातेजा इरिणे वर्वृताना [[Rv. 10. 34. 1.]] 
-णः Calamus Scriptorious (Mar. बोरू), [[Mb. 2.]]
a. Belonging or relating to a desert.

a. Ved. 
__1 Instigating. 
__2 Powerful, violent, an instigator; न येषामिरी सधस्थ ईष्ट आँ [[Rv. 5. 87. 3.]] 
__3 A proud or overbearing fellow.
m. N. of a Ṛṣi of the family of Kaṇva (author of several hynms of the Rigveda).
or इरिविल्लिका Pimples on the head.

p. p. 
__1 Sent, despatched. 
__2 Said, uttered &c.; °आकूतम् declared purpose or intention.

a. [ईर्-इनन्] Desert, barren. 
-णम् A desert, barren soil; मुहूर्तमिव निःशब्दमासीदीरिणसंनिभम् [[Rām. 1. 55. 24.]]
